name: Enterprise SLA Orchestration Engine – Escalation Chains & Automatic Actions

parameters.content:
## Enterprise SLA Orchestration Engine

Receives an incident or ticket, calculates SLA deadlines, detects breaches, walks an escalation chain, triggers automatic actions, and returns a full orchestration report.

### All nodes (1-line each)
1. Webhook - Incident / Ticket Intake – Receives the incident or ticket payload via POST.
2. Code - Validate & Calculate SLA – Validates the request and computes response/resolution deadlines.
3. Code - Detect Breach Status – Determines whether the SLA is on-track, at-risk or already breached.
4. Wait - Pre Escalation Eval – Short pause before escalation evaluation.
5. Code - Build Escalation Plan – Selects the required escalation levels and automatic actions based on severity and breach state.
6. Wait - Pre Level 1 Action – Pause before Level-1 automatic action.
7. HTTP Request - Level 1 Action – Executes Level-1 action (notify assignee / create task).
8. Code - Process Level 1 – Records Level-1 result and decides if further escalation is needed.
9. Wait - Pre Level 2 Action – Pause before Level-2 escalation action.
10. HTTP Request - Level 2 Action – Executes Level-2 action (notify manager / reassign).
11. Code - Process Level 2 – Records Level-2 result and decides if final escalation is required.
12. Wait - Pre Level 3 Action – Pause before Level-3 (executive) action.
13. HTTP Request - Level 3 Action – Executes Level-3 action (executive alert / war-room).
14. Code - Process Level 3 – Records Level-3 result.
15. Code - Build Orchestration Report – Aggregates breach status, escalation steps and actions into a final report.
16. Code - Finalize Response – Assembles the response payload for the caller.
17. Respond to Webhook – Returns the complete SLA orchestration result.

## 1. Intake & SLA Calculation

Webhook - Incident / Ticket Intake – Receives the incident or ticket payload via POST.
Code - Validate & Calculate SLA – Validates the request and computes response/resolution deadlines.
Code - Detect Breach Status – Determines whether the SLA is on-track, at-risk or already breached.

## 2. Escalation Chain & Actions

Wait - Pre Escalation Eval – Short pause before escalation evaluation.
Code - Build Escalation Plan – Selects the required escalation levels and automatic actions based on severity and breach state.
Wait - Pre Level 1 Action – Pause before Level-1 automatic action.
HTTP Request - Level 1 Action – Executes Level-1 action (notify assignee / create task).
Code - Process Level 1 – Records Level-1 result and decides if further escalation is needed.
Wait - Pre Level 2 Action – Pause before Level-2 escalation action.
HTTP Request - Level 2 Action – Executes Level-2 action (notify manager / reassign).
Code - Process Level 2 – Records Level-2 result and decides if final escalation is required.
Wait - Pre Level 3 Action – Pause before Level-3 (executive) action.
HTTP Request - Level 3 Action – Executes Level-3 action (executive alert / war-room).
Code - Process Level 3 – Records Level-3 result.

## 3. Report & Respond

Code - Build Orchestration Report – Aggregates breach status, escalation steps and actions into a final report.
Code - Finalize Response – Assembles the response payload for the caller.
Respond to Webhook – Returns the complete SLA orchestration result.
